documents.title: Bambu Filament Technical Data Sheet V2.0: PLA-CF
Bambu PLA CF Safety Data Sheet SDS20260701A50 (Jul. 01. 2026)
Bambu Lab Filament Hex Code Table - PLA-CF
Filament guide - Printer, Nozzle, AMS, Build Plate, Glue Compatibility and Required Parameters

notes: TDS rows with no registry key (not stored): Spool Size "Diameter: 200 mm; Height: 67 mm"; Printing and Storage Humidity "< 20% RH ( Sealed, with desiccant )"; Bed Surface Preparation "Glue"; Retraction Length 0.6 - 1.0 mm; Retraction Speed 20 - 40 mm/s; Max Overhang Angle 55°; Max Bridging Length 30 mm; Support Material "Support for PLA"; Melt Index 3.7 ± 0.6 g/10 min (210 °C, 2.16 kg); Crystallization Temperature N/A; Saturated Water Absorption Rate 0.42% (25 °C, 55% RH); Young's Modulus 2790 ± 120 MPa (X-Y) / 2160 ± 90 MPa (Z); the Other Physical and Chemical Properties table (odorless, composition, insoluble in water, not resistant to acid/alkali, flammable, combustion products water and carbon oxides); suggested annealing 55 to 60 °C for 6 to 12 hours.
Z-direction mechanical values and the notched / second impact row are kept in each mechanical row's note, not stored (one key per scope).

Drying in AMS 2 Pro / AMS HT (45 °C, 12 h) and on a printer heatbed (TDS: X1 Series 65 - 75 °C, 12 h; drying wiki: 65-75 °C, 12 h; PLA wiki: 70 ℃, 12 h) has no registry key or scope of its own; the oven values are stored.

Nozzle: 0.4 mm high-flow nozzle "Not Recommended" (material-table wiki) / "not recommended" (PLA wiki, poor overhang quality); not written as a relation (not recommended is not incompatible). The store page's "Stainless Steel Nozzle NOT Recommended" is covered by the hardened-steel requirement.
Hex values are kept exactly as the document prints them (mixed case); Levonis normalises colour hex to lower case.
in_the_box: no official text list in the documents read.

safety.certifications: the store page links a "Filament RoHS" PDF (https://store.bblcdn.com/927b92a153514ded9e49b6c40ab85d79.pdf) that was not cached and not read, so the key is neither stored nor marked not_published.
Safety (owner may show): the SDS (section 8) and store FAQ ask for gloves when loading/unloading, cutting or sanding (carbon-fibre debris); the PLA wiki adds safety goggles.
